shortDescription: Manage virtual machines on NetActuate infrastructure.

options.name: auth_token
options.description: API Key which should be set in ENV variable HOSTVIRTUAL_API_KEY C(auth_token) is required.

options.name: build
options.description: Request provisioning of sessions to fulfil requirements as defined by parameters.

options.name: group_id
options.description: The unique NetActuate-provided BGP group identifier with which to associate requested sessions.

options.name: hostname
options.description: Hostname of the node for which to provision sessions and/or retrieve session configuration details.

options.name: ipv6
options.description: Request IPv6 sessions in addition to IPv4.

options.name: mbpkgid
options.description: The purchased package ID the node is associated with. Optional if C(hostname) is a unique identifier.

options.name: redundant
options.description: Request two sessions be provisioned for redundancy.
